_read: Two reads. FIRST: the photographs, cropped to the result column and enlarged, read 18.09.2026. SECOND: cell_resolution_2026-09-09.tsv, the Head of QC's own reading pass over the scans, which names the document, its issue date and the laboratory for each determination. A value is applied only where the two agree AND the resolution pass names a citable document; where the pass says NOTHING ON FILE the figure is recorded here and NOT printed.
